source.rules: ARA Rally Technical Rules, 2026 Edition (through Bulletin 2026-8)

items.label: Helmet
items.accepts: Snell SA2015 (valid through 12/31/2026), EA2016, SA2020 or SA2025; FIA 8860-2010, 8860-2018, 8859-2015 or 8859-2024; not modified from manufacture

items.label: Suit
items.accepts: FIA 8856-2000, 8856-2018 or FIA 1986; SFI 3.2A/5 or 3.4/5; SFI 3.2A/1 only with FIA 8856-2000 or SFI 3.3 underwear; no withdrawn homologations

items.label: HNR
items.accepts: FIA 8858-2002 or 8858-2010, or SFI 38.1 with conformance label less than 5 years old

items.label: Deficiency Repaired?
items.accepts: Deviations or damage noted in the log book at previous events have been repaired

items.label: Parking Lights
items.accepts: All legally required exterior lights present and working

items.label: Headlights, Low/High Beam
items.accepts: Low and high beams work and meet state of registration requirements; auxiliary lights no higher than top of hood

items.label: Turn Signals
items.accepts: All legally required exterior lights present and working

items.label: Tow Loop
items.accepts: Towing eye at front, painted yellow, red or orange; fluorescent arrow if under the car

items.label: Horn
items.accepts: Adequate and functioning

items.label: Windshield Wipers
items.accepts: Adequate and functioning

items.label: Taillights
items.accepts: All legally required exterior lights present and working

items.label: Stoplights
items.accepts: All legally required exterior lights present and working

items.label: Turn Signals
items.accepts: All legally required exterior lights present and working

items.label: Reverse Lights
items.accepts: Working; switch on only when reverse gear is engaged

items.label: License Plate Lights
items.accepts: All legally required exterior lights present and working

items.label: Tow Loop
items.accepts: Towing eye at rear, painted yellow, red or orange; fluorescent arrow if under the car

items.label: Event use item 1
items.accepts: As required by the event supplementary regulations

items.label: Event use item 2
items.accepts: As required by the event supplementary regulations

items.label: Roll Cage Legality
items.accepts: Fully welded cage to FIA Appendix J Art. 253 (or FIA-homologated with papers) entered in a recognized log book; pre-2009 log books with 2006 RA-spec cage plus required retrofits; no bolt-together members

items.label: FIA or SFI Roll Cage Padding
items.accepts: FIA 8857-2001 Type A or SFI 45.1 on all roofline tubing forward of and including the main hoop and any tube the helmet can reach

items.label: Floor Pan & Firewall Sealed
items.accepts: No holes in floor pan or firewall; fuel-resistant, fire-retardant shield between cockpit and fuel tank/filler/pump area

items.label: Door Panel & Edge Trim
items.accepts: Inside front door panels or edge trim protect from metal edges

items.label: Restraints: SFI 2 – FIA 5 Yrs
items.accepts: Unmodified 5-, 6- or 7-point harness for both crew, FIA 8853/98 or 8853/2016 or SFI 16.1/16.5, single-latch release, not past label expiration (SFI 2 yrs, FIA 5 yrs; dual FIA/SFI: later date); no mixed parts

items.label: Seats Secure
items.accepts: FIA 8855-1999 or 8862-2009 (or racing seat accepted by Chief Scrutineer); no hinged-back or OEM seats; securely mounted, no sliders

items.label: Rear View Mirror
items.accepts: Present, secure and usable

items.label: Battery Secure / + Covered
items.accepts: Securely mounted to primary structure; hot terminal insulated; relocated wet-cell batteries in covered non-conductive box; lithium batteries with BMS

items.label: Fuel Tank or Cell
items.accepts: OEM tank in OEM location with OEM mounts, or FIA/SFI fuel cell vented outside (spill outlet if in luggage compartment); exposed underside shielded; no supplementary tanks

items.label: Fuel Pump Auto Shut Off
items.accepts: Fuel pumps run only with engine running, except while starting

items.label: Fuel Cell Bulkhead
items.accepts: Fuel-resistant, fire-retardant shield between cockpit and tank/filler/pump; fuel pumps isolated by fireproof metal bulkhead

items.label: Fire Ex. 2 x 10 B:C or 1 x 20 B:C
items.accepts: 2 x 10 B:C or 1 x 20 B:C hand-held (or listed clean-agent equivalents); metal strap, visible gauge, serviced annually or per FIA/SFI, DOT/USCG/SFI/FIA approved; one within reach of a seated crew member; exterior location label

items.label: On Board Ext. SFI or FIA
items.accepts: SFI 17.1, FIA 8865-2015 or FIA Technical List 16 (Rally) system; nozzles to engine bay and cockpit; metal strap, visible gauge; activation within reach of both crew; 2 circle-E decals

items.label: Labeled Triangles x2+1 in Reach
items.accepts: 3 self-supporting reflective triangles, min. 12 in per side, marked with car number; one within reach of a seated crew member

items.label: First Aid Kit
items.accepts: Comprehensive kit in the cockpit, easily accessible and removable by hand, clearly identified; exterior first-aid label

items.label: Tow Rope
items.accepts: Tow rope (or winch with cable) carried entirely inside the car

items.label: Safety & Spares Secure
items.accepts: All articles that could be dangerous if loose are securely restrained

items.label: Spill Kit
items.accepts: At least 2 x 15" x 19" absorbent pads, 1 x 3" x 48" hydrocarbon sock and a 13 gal bag, in a resealable heavy-duty bag

items.label: Tracker Power / Mount Secure
items.accepts: Tracking unit powered and securely mounted per event instructions

items.label: Restrictor
items.accepts: Forced induction inlet no larger than Table A for the class (e.g. Open/Limited 4WD 33 mm @ 2.5 bar abs), min. 3 mm wide, within 50 mm of compressor wheel, sealable with ARA wire seal; novice restrictor max 30 mm where required

items.label: Battery Secure/ + covered
items.accepts: Securely mounted to primary structure; hot terminal insulated

items.label: Boost Monitor Operable
items.accepts: 1/8" female fitting in intake plenum for ARA boost monitor; FIA pop-off valve sealed where used

items.label: Tires and Wheels (incl. Spare)
items.accepts: Tires, including all spares, adequate and in good condition

items.label: Brakes (incl. Parking)
items.accepts: Brakes adequate and functioning; parking brake holds the empty car with 50 kg pull at a tow point
